# Test the hidden betool wire-codec subcommand surface (offline, no auth).
# Payload round-trip fidelity is covered by TestBetool in betool_test.go and
# by the codec tests in internal/batchexecute; this script covers dispatch,
# visibility, and error handling.

# betool is hidden from help.
exec ./nlm_test --help
! stderr 'betool'

# betool is hidden even under --experimental (like other developer tools).
exec ./nlm_test --experimental --help
! stderr 'betool'

# Missing mode errors and exits non-zero.
! exec ./nlm_test betool
stderr 'missing mode'

# Unknown mode errors and exits non-zero.
! exec ./nlm_test betool frobnicate
stderr 'unknown mode'

# help mode prints usage and exits 0.
exec ./nlm_test betool help
stderr 'Translate raw batchexecute'
stderr 'decode-request'
stderr 'encode-response'

# The documented round-trip example must decode with --json, since the encode
# modes consume JSON and the decode default is now human-readable text. This
# guards the regression where the example showed a plain decode-response piped
# into encode-response (which fails on the text output).
exec ./nlm_test betool help
stderr 'nlm --json betool decode-response'

# Default decode output is human-readable text, not JSON: it names the RPC and
# previews the data, and is NOT the structured "responses" JSON that
# encode-response consumes. (The JSON round-trip is covered in Go by
# TestBetoolRoundTripResponse.)
exec ./nlm_test betool decode-response testdata/betool/response.txt
stdout 'response'
stdout 'CCqFvf'
! stdout '"responses"'

# The same body with the global --json flag emits the structured JSON that
# encode-response can round-trip.
exec ./nlm_test --json betool decode-response testdata/betool/response.txt
stdout '"responses"'
stdout '"CCqFvf"'

# Too many arguments is rejected.
! exec ./nlm_test betool decode-request a.txt b.txt
stderr 'at most one input file'

# A missing input file is reported clearly (does not require auth).
! exec ./nlm_test betool decode-request does-not-exist.txt
stderr 'read does-not-exist.txt'
! stderr 'Authentication required'

# --proto/--verify only apply to decode modes.
! exec ./nlm_test betool encode-request --proto
stderr 'apply only to decode'

# Unknown flag is rejected.
! exec ./nlm_test betool decode-response --bogus
stderr 'unknown flag'
